title: Held-out evaluation across people, tasks and time
summary: Held-out trials, people, tasks and later sessions as different generalisation questions, each with its information contract; leave-one-subject-out evaluation of choice models; scoring by log-likelihood and percentage of choices predicted against baselines.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the outline below names its scope and sources.

preparation.description: Read the Action prediction section of Dezfouli et al. (2019).
Read their model selection by leave-one-out cross-validation over subjects.
Read the study design of Eckstein et al. (2022): three tasks done by the same 291 participants.
